issue.title: Print SVG image embeds in bob ref create Markdown PDFs
issue.description: A Markdown bob ref create never fails on an SVG image embed; each SVG prints as a vector PDF, else a same-stem sibling raster, else a visible placeholder with a warning.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202611/ref_create_svg_images.md requests this work

issue.title: Always-on SVG image guard
issue.description: svg-image-guard: add an always-on Lua image filter that swaps SVG embeds for a same-stem sibling raster or an Image-not-printable placeholder, reports them as images:/warning: lines, fixes the misleading svg.sty hint, and documents the behavior.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/ref_create_svg_images.md defines phase svg-image-guard as one work unit

issue.title: Vector SVG rendering through the Chrome diagram renderer
issue.description: svg-vector-render: extend the Mermaid diagram pass and adapter protocol so local SVG embeds render to vector PDFs in the same browser launch, falling back to the guard, then optionally recapture the failed report.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/ref_create_svg_images.md defines phase svg-vector-render as one work unit

payload.entry: LAND AUDIT / FOLLOW-UP TRIAGE before remaining-work tale: reviewed every note on k6.1 and k6.2 (both closed done), the approved plan, DECISIONS recapture=yes, epic commits 52f0d615 and 7eb82440, and source/Lua/adapter/tests/docs. k6.2 records just install and successful keep_moving_link_marks capture (2/2 Mermaid, 1/1 SVG, exit 0); retain that completed acceptance. Fetched origin/master remains 7eb82440. Reviewed intervening non-epic b2c3697e, dcc1986e, ba3f51ba and post-creation ba9867a5; none touches or duplicates the SVG pipeline, so no integration edits are needed. Four remaining epic defects: (1) production prescan returns 0 for angle-bracket paths with spaces and multiline inline/reference image destinations, though actual Pandoc collection returns one SVG; (2) Pandoc default typewise collection emits a later SVG before an earlier Mermaid fence, violating document order/shared-budget precedence; (3) inline SVG sanitizer excludes root on* attributes, confirmed with a harmless root onmouseover handler still present at print and executing when dispatched in offline Chrome; (4) Markdown and plain-note overwrite paths discard image guard/diagram summaries and warnings. These belong to this epic and are in a bounded medium landing tale, not new tasks. Root onload was not observed to fire automatically; the confirmed event test explicitly dispatched mouseover. Browser probe needed TMPDIR=/tmp to avoid Chromium socket-path length failure. FOLLOW-UP OUTCOMES: k6.1 note #1 and k6.2 note #1 mounted pages independently reproduce with just docs-check on 7eb82440: panel 6036, previews 6177, keyboard 6060, navigation-hotkeys 6186, protocol 6149 against cap 6000. Used sase_new_task same-type search, recent sweep, and active-epic review; recorded +1 on existing bob-cli-jz and bob-cli-h9, no new causal owner and no duplicate tasks. Declined k6.2 json-outputs proposal because ba3f51ba fixes that overage and current docs-check has no such failure. No epic-symbol entries; no symvision recipe. Parent link is absent. No source edits or check-full run this turn. Epic intentionally remains open for the tale to repair, verify with just check and adapter checks, and close in the same coding turn.
